text:
Good morning,

I am interested in renting the 1959 Pemberley Countess for our wedding. We plan to collect it on April 25, 2027 at 09:00 and return it on Monday 26 April 2027 at 9:30 am. We would like it delivered to the Glasshouse at Fernhollow, and it should be nicely decorated with ribbons and flowers on the car.

Sincerely,
Posy Holloway-Pike
+70 437 248 3581
